name: MuBank bonds MU and MUG at the live pair quote
summary: MuBank.mu_bond and mu_gold_bond pay out the bank's MU and MUG at quotes computed from live reserves of the Trader Joe USDC.e/MU and MU/MUG pairs. Inside a flash swap of MU from the MU/MUG pair, the attacker dumped MU into USDC.e/MU to skew the quote, bonded 10,290 USDC.e for excess MU and MUG, and sold them back.
notes: Each bond mints MuMoney, which only the address in MuMoney's muBank slot may do. That needed MuBank.setMuMoneyAddress and then MuMoney.setMuBankAddress(MuBank), a mint grant 161 blocks later, which sets the age.

MU and MUG are valued at realised proceeds (rule 15) because the attacker's own sale crashed MU: 0.222229 USD per MU from the final 259,460 MU sale, and 18.7728 MU per MUG from the MUG sale. The 10,290 USDC.e the attacker paid into the bank is not subtracted (rule 14).
